Materials used in the craft of scaffolding can include:
•bamboo poles (Bambusa pervariabilis McClure and Phyllostachys edulis or moso bamboo)
•timber of Cunninghamia lanceolata
•strips of bamboo skin (or nylon strips)
•palm leaves (or canvas)
•bamboo mats ( or nylon mesh)

“Behind me is a typical Hong Kong old building maintenance project. To construct a bamboo scaffolding for a 16-storey high structure like this, you'll need about 10 workers. If we were to use metal scaffolding, we could never finish all this in a week.” “In the past, the wages of bamboo scaffolding workers were the highest in the entire construction industry. But that is no longer the case.” “The reason I am not too worried about it being replaced in Hong Kong is that the practical environment in Hong Kong still requires bamboo scaffolding. Why? First, in terms of cost, many citizens cannot afford something else. The cost of metal scaffolding is nearly three times that of bamboo. I believe that preserving our traditional culture is something we take pride in. It represents Hong Kong's construction industry.”

“After finishing these scaffoldings, these stage scaffoldings... I feel a sense of accomplishment. Bamboo scaffolding is a skill... among us Chinese people. It is not something foreigners can copy. For any kind of work, whether it's building scaffolding for construction sites or building cultural air domes like we do, I don't want it to be abolished.”

“It requires experience and knowledge of how to utilise the materials effectively. Some young people prefer to use technology and avoid physically demanding work. But it's not particularly hard work... it's just that you are exposed to the sun and rain. However, many young people are still reluctant to join the industry.”

“I find it magical, that's why since I started working in scaffolding, I have been continuously learning. When I first started in the industry, I was scared of heights. I didn't believe only a few knots could hold dozens of levels. You can see that Hong Kong has a rich bamboo scaffolding culture, because, even though I am a newcomer, I feel like it's not just for large construction sites, there are also stage air domes and artistic scaffoldings. When I walk past scaffolding like here today, it instantly catches my eye. I think they are astonishing. I find it magical how the scaffolding can create such beautiful structures. I really like them and have even taken some photos to look at and admire.”

“We are inside my art installation. So this is my bamboo art installation. I really think that bamboo is a very traditional material in Hong Kong, representing the construction industry. And more importantly, this is this circular material. The bamboos come from different festivals.” “I love bamboo because it's really sustainable.” “Bamboo is one of the first materials on my drawing board. I advocate green buildings and also the green material. How can we adopt bamboo into modern architectural projects?”
